First release.

- Conversion to 88.2, 96, 176.4, 192, 352.8 or 384 kHz, in 32-bit float, 64-bit float or dithered 24-bit.
- High-frequency extension for rolled-off sources, with strength, rolloff, ultrasonic reach and a manual cutoff.
- Air shelf.
- Preview before saving: spectrum, spectrograms, sample-level waveform comparison.
- Listen to the original, the result, or only what was added, with octave-shift and slow-down auditions.
- Time, frequency and box selections that limit playback.

Download `Ultraviolet-Setup.exe`. Windows 11 x64.
